battle.name: 淮西之戰
battle.brief: 至元十年二月元軍取襄樊，四月設淮西樞密院，在正陽夾淮河築東西二城，圖取兩淮以瞰長江。南宋遣黃州陳奕、淮西安撫制置使夏貴攻之，宋軍十萬水軍一戰潰敗，戰艦盡失。弩手立於城頭與舟首，仍守不住正陽，元軍自此在兩淮站穩腳跟，牽制性攻勢轉為直取臨安的前哨。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 淮西之戰是南宋咸淳九年至德祐元年（1273至1275）間，元軍在淮河下游西岸對南宋兩淮地區發動的一連串攻勢，隸屬於宋元戰爭的主戰略。開戰背景是襄樊被圍四年有餘，1273年二月元軍攻下襄陽、樊城，長江中游的門戶自此洞開。宋方以兩淮為北方最後的屏障，防御由沿江制置司與淮西安撫制置司分掌：沿江制置副使兼知黃州陳奕統安豐、廬州、壽州諸州兵馬，淮西安撫制置使夏貴總攏兩淮水軍與州縣守軍，朝中則由丞相賈似道主持和議與調度，各路互不統屬，遇事互相推諉。元方由中書省直接運作：世祖忽必烈命中書左丞相合丹、河南行省參知政事劉整、都元帥塔出與董文炳行淮西樞密院事，置淮西行省與行院府於正陽，又命伯顏、史天澤在荊湖行省籌備直取臨安。都元帥塔出統淮西前線兵馬，與董文炳、阿塔海同在正陽一線；漢人將領劉整熟悉宋地山川城塞，漢軍與蒙古、色目軍混編在同一套軍令之下，元廷用漢人的地理知識配蒙古人的騎兵與砲手，這是本戰區與襄樊戰區共通的特色。
countriesEn: The Battle of Huai-Xi was a series of Yuan offensive operations in the western part of the lower Huai River against the Southern Song's Two Huai frontier between 1273 and 1275, a subordinate action within the larger Song-Yuan war. The immediate occasion was the fall of Xiangyang and Fancheng, which had been under siege for more than four years and were taken by the Yuan in the second month of 1273, leaving the middle Yangtze wide open. On the Song side the Two Huai were treated as the empire's last northern screen, and defence was split between the Along-River Circuit and the Huai-Xi Pacification Circuit: Chen Yi, deputy commissioner of the Along-River Circuit and governor of Huangzhou, led the troops of Anfeng, Luzhou and Shouzhou, while Xia Gui, pacification commissioner of Huai-Xi, gathered the Two Huai fleets and the garrisons of the prefectures; at court the chancellor Jia Sidao handled both the negotiations with the Mongols and the dispatch of reinforcements, so the contingents shared no single chain of command and blamed one another whenever a position was lost. On the Yuan side the war was run directly from the Central Secretariat: Kublai Khan appointed Hedaan, Liu Zheng, Ta Chu and Dong Wenbing as commissioners of the Huai-Xi Privy Council, and established a provincial administration and council offices at Zhengyang, while Bayan and Shi Tianze were sent to the Jinghu Circuit to prepare the direct strike against Lin'an. General Ta Chu held the forward line in Huai-Xi together with Dong Wenbing and Ataqai, and Liu Zheng, a Han Chinese general who knew the Song terrain and fortresses intimately, served within the same order of battle as the Mongol and Semu contingents. The Yuan therefore paired Han Chinese geographical expertise with Mongol cavalry and stone throwers, a feature shared with the Xiangyang theatre.
people: 忽必烈是這條戰線的總指揮。至元十年四月，他以中書省的名義把淮西從地方行政區升格為獨立的軍事樞紐：任命合丹、劉整、塔出、董文炳行淮西樞密院事，並准許在正陽夾淮河築東西兩城、設行院府，此後兩淮的每一次用兵都從這座城調度。伯顏、史天澤被派往荊湖行省籌備攻臨安，可見元廷的真正目標從一開始就是臨安，淮西只是為正面進攻打開側翼並抽走宋方的北援。宋方在正陽前線最關鍵的人是陳奕，他以沿江制置副使兼知黃州的職銜，於1273年冬率安豐、廬州、壽州兵馬反覆進攻尚未完工的正陽城，令築城工程屢屢中斷。1274年夏接替他的是淮西安撫制置使夏貴，集兩淮兵將與十萬水軍攻正陽，志在拔掉元軍這顆釘子。元軍正面由都元帥塔出與參知政事董文炳同守。塔出每日出戰十餘次，屢挫宋軍；董文炳在流矢貫穿左臂及脅下時拔矢再戰，連發四十餘箭，箭盡後又向隨員索取十餘支，最後力竭而弓不能張滿。救援由淮西行院副使阿塔海與部將懷都配合：塔出冒雨突破宋軍包圍入城，天晴後分率精兵出城，渡至淮河中流，與在大人洲與宋軍交戰的劉整互相策應，擊敗宋軍，斬首數千級，奪戰艦五百餘艘，正陽之圍遂解。
peopleEn: Kublai Khan was the overall director of this front. In the fourth month of 1273 he used the authority of the Central Secretariat to raise Huai-Xi from a provincial administration into an independent military pivot: Hedaan, Liu Zheng, Ta Chu and Dong Wenbing were appointed commissioners of the Huai-Xi Privy Council, and they were authorised to build two walled towns on the two banks of the Huai at Zhengyang and to set up council offices there; from that moment every operation in the Two Huai was directed from those walls. Bayan and Shi Tianze were posted to the Jinghu Circuit to prepare the assault on Lin'an, which makes it clear that Lin'an, not Huai-Xi, was the real objective, and that Huai-Xi was opened to loosen the Song's northern flank and draw off its reinforcements. The key Song figure at Zhengyang was Chen Yi, who as deputy commissioner of the Along-River Circuit and governor of Huangzhou led the troops of Anfeng, Luzhou and Shouzhou in repeated attacks on the unfinished walls through the winter of 1273, interrupting the construction work again and again. He was replaced in the summer of 1274 by Xia Gui, pacification commissioner of Huai-Xi, who concentrated the troops of the Two Huai and a fleet of one hundred thousand men against Zhengyang in order to pull the nail out. On the Yuan side the walls were held by General Ta Chu and Commissioner Dong Wenbing. Ta Chu fought out of the gates more than a dozen times a day and repeatedly threw the Song back; Dong Wenbing, when a stray shaft ran through his left arm and his side, pulled it out and kept shooting, loosing more than forty arrows and then asking his attendants for another dozen or so, until at last his strength failed and the bow could no be drawn full. Relief came through Ataqai, deputy commissioner of the Huai-Xi council, and the officer Huai Du: Ta Chu broke through the Song encirclement in the pouring rain and entered the city, and when the sky cleared he led picked troops out of the gate, crossed to midstream of the Huai, and fought in concert with Liu Zheng's detachment, which was engaging the Song at the Great Man islet. The Song were beaten, several thousand heads were taken, and more than five hundred warships were captured, which relieved Zhengyang.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩是宋代城防與水軍的標準配備，也是讀懂淮西攻防的鑰匙。弩的好處是拉力可以先存進弩機，射手不必像拉弓那樣靠腰背反覆發力，上弦之後可以據高俯射，箭矢平直、破甲力強，一個人也能在城頭持續壓制；壞處是裝填慢，野戰中一旦被騎兵貼近就難以再射。正陽的攻防正好把兩面都照出來：元軍在夾淮河的兩座新城中設弩手，居高壓住宋軍的攻城隊與水上船隊；宋方在壽州、廬州一帶的城頭同樣布滿弩手，並把弩陣架在戰艦上當作活動的射擊平台。1273年冬，陳奕部自六安派出的戰艦打算順流攻擊正陽，被塔出遣騎兵焚燒，說明舟師是宋軍在淮西唯一能倚仗的攻擊手段，也正是元軍必欲先除的目標。1274年夏，夏貴集水軍十萬、戰艦數百再攻正陽，元軍除以城頭弩手射擊外，另以配重式投石砲（回回砲）遠程砸擊城垣與密集的船隊，宋軍損失戰艦五百餘艘。攻城與守城的其他裝備同樣入鏡：元軍備攻城塔、撞木，渡淮時以臨時木橋與淺灘涉渡，宿營地按營盤掘壕立柵；宋軍水師用樓船、鬥艦與遮篷快舟，岸上則靠投石機與弓弩壓制，士卒多靠舟船攜帶三日乾糧與繩索繫岸。弩手在正陽的意義，是在被圍的一方始終能把對方的接近距離壓在有效射程之外，讓攻城者每一步都要先付出箭矢的代價。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card face was standard equipment for Song city garrisons and river fleets, and it is the key to reading the fighting at Huai-Xi. Its advantage is that the pull is stored in the mechanism, so the shooter does not have to keep driving with the back and loins as an archer must; once cocked it can be loosed from a high position, the bolt flies flat and pierces armour, and a single man can keep up a steady fire from a parapet. Its weakness is the slow reload, which makes it fragile once cavalry get close in open ground. The fighting at Zhengyang showed both faces of the weapon: the Yuan posted crossbowmen in the two new towns on either side of the Huai to shoot down on the Song assault columns and on the boats of the river fleet; the Song likewise filled the walls of Shouzhou and Luzhou with crossbowmen and mounted the crossbow sections on warships so they could move as a floating platform. In the winter of 1273 the warships Chen Yi sent down from Liu'an to strike Zhengyang were burned by cavalry sent by Ta Chu, which shows that the river fleet was the only offensive instrument the Song still had in Huai-Xi and therefore the first target the Yuan had to remove. In the summer of 1274 Xia Gui brought up one hundred thousand men and several hundred warships against Zhengyang again; besides the crossbow fire from the walls the Yuan used counterweight stone throwers, the huihui pao, to smash the ramparts and the crowded hulls at long range, and the Song lost more than five hundred warships. Other equipment of both the assault and the defence is visible in the same theatre: the Yuan brought up siege towers and battering beams, crossed the Huai over improvised timber bridges and through the shallows, and dug trenched camps with stockades; the Song fleet used tower ships, fighting junks and light covered boats, while on shore they relied on stone throwers and bows and crossbows, and the soldiers for the most part carried three days of dry rations and mooring ropes in the boats. The meaning of the crossbow at Zhengyang was that the besieged could always hold the enemy's approach inside the weapon's effective range, making every step of the assault cost the attacker arrows first.
tactics: 元軍在淮西採取的是典型的圍城與牽制並行：先以襄樊為支點解決上游，再在正陽夾淮河築東西兩城，控制渡口與南北水陸通道，使南宋兩淮與長江下游的聯繫變得脆弱。築城本身就是戰術目標，因為只要兩城立住，宋廷就無法再抽調兩淮兵力北上；城未成而先築，正是陳奕反覆攻打的著眼點。1274年暮春，元廷採納謀臣之議，兩淮城堅兵精不宜強攻，遂留兵淮西牽制宋軍，主力由伯顏、史天澤在荊湖行省另籌，渡江東下。守方戰術以水軍為主軸：夏貴集十萬人舟師，以船隻列陣逼近城下，先以流矢與弓弩覆蓋城頭，再決開淮水灌浸外郭，企圖以水攻配合攻城器械；董文炳一面讓士卒退避，一面留兒子董士選代戰，自己帶創督陣，把宋軍一名部將生擒，逼退宋軍鋒頭。塔出聞訊率兵在潁州大破宋軍援兵，冒雨突圍入城與董文炳合守；天晴後元軍分率精兵出城，渡至淮河中流與宋軍接戰，步兵在河西岸策應，兩處戰場互為犄角，終以斬首數千級、奪戰艦五百餘艘解正陽之圍，阿塔海追擊宋軍至安豐城下。元軍另一手是反制水戰：得知宋軍戰艦自六安來襲，即遣騎兵火攻焚毀，切斷宋軍的水上攻勢。
tacticsEn: The Yuan combined siege with fixation in Huai-Xi. First they solved the upper river by making Xiangyang the pivot, then they built the two towns at Zhengyang on either bank of the Huai in order to control the fords and the land and water routes running north and south, which thinned the link between the Song's Two Huai and the lower Yangtze. The building of the walls was itself an operational aim: once the two towns stood, the Song court could no longer draw troops out of the Two Huai to march north, and the fact that the walls were raised before the work was finished was precisely what Chen Yi's repeated attacks were aimed at. In late spring of 1274 the Yuan court accepted the advice of its ministers that the fortified, well-manned cities of the Two Huai should not be assaulted directly, and therefore left troops in Huai-Xi to pin the Song while the main force was prepared by Bayan and Shi Tianze in the Jinghu Circuit for the march down the river. The Song tactic rested on the fleet as its main axis: Xia Gui brought up one hundred thousand men in boats, closed with the ships to the foot of the walls, covered the parapets first with stray shafts and bows and crossbows, and then opened the Huai to flood the outer enceinte, hoping to combine the assault engines with a water attack. Dong Wenbing ordered his men back, put his son Dong Shixuan forward to fight in his place and stayed in the line himself despite his wounds, taking one of Xia Gui's officers alive and forcing the Song back a little. Ta Chu, hearing of the attack, brought down the Song relief force at Yingzhou, broke through the encirclement in heavy rain and entered the city to hold it with Dong Wenbing. When the weather cleared the Yuan led picked troops out of the gate, fought the Song in midstream of the Huai, and had infantry supporting the action on the west bank, so that the two battlefields supported one another; the Song were beaten with several thousand heads taken and more than five hundred warships captured, and Zhengyang was relieved, Ataqai pursuing the Song back to the foot of Anfeng. The other side of Yuan method was the counter-stroke against the fleet: as soon as it was known that Song warships were coming down from Liu'an, cavalry were sent to burn them, cutting the Song waterborne offensive off at the root.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。襄樊之圍自1268年9月起到1273年2月元軍破城，前後四年有餘，是宋元戰爭中歷時最長的城池攻防，淮西戰線正立在這次勝利之上。1274年夏，宋方投入的兵員記錄是十萬水軍，由淮西安撫制置使夏貴率領；同年夏正陽城下之戰，元軍斬首數千級、奪戰艦五百餘艘，這兩個數字由《續資治通鑑》與《元史》互證，數量雖大而無更細的分項記載。塔出在攻安豐、廬州、壽州三處州縣時，俘虜逾一萬人，是史書在本戰役留下的唯一一筆俘虜總數。守將董文炳在城頭連發四十餘箭，箭盡後再向隨員索取十餘支，射出的箭數超過五十，箭矢貫穿其左臂與脅下仍繼續作戰，記錄具體可考。地理尺度上，正陽在霍邱縣東北，夾淮河築城；潁州在正陽以北，路程約百餘里；安豐、壽州在正陽以南數十里；廬州再往南約二百餘里。元軍築城自1273年春動工，夏日已見城基，宋將陳奕在1273年冬的攻擊正是為了中斷這項工程。攻守雙方還有可計量的器械：宋軍十萬人配戰艦數百艘，元軍在正陽城頭佈弩陣並備回回砲與砲車，水路則利用淮河本身的水位與流速。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. The siege of Xiangyang and Fancheng ran from the ninth month of 1268 to the second month of 1273, when the Yuan took the cities: more than four years in all, the longest siege of the Song-Yuan war, and the whole Huai-Xi front was founded on that victory. In the summer of 1274 the Song committed one hundred thousand men in the river fleet under Xia Gui, pacification commissioner of Huai-Xi; in the fighting below Zhengyang that summer the Yuan took several thousand heads and more than five hundred warships, two numbers corroborated by the Xu Zizhi Tongjian and the Yuan Shi, large in scale but without finer breakdowns. When Ta Chu attacked the prefectures of Anfeng, Luzhou and Shouzhou he took more than ten thousand prisoners, the only total of captives recorded for this campaign. The defending commander Dong Wenbing loosed more than forty arrows from the parapet and then asked his attendants for another dozen or so, so that more than fifty bolts were shot, and a shaft that ran through his left arm and his side did not stop him. In terms of distance, Zhengyang lies to the north-east of Huoqiu county with the two towns built across the Huai; Yingzhou lies a little more than a hundred li to the north; Anfeng and Shouzhou are several tens of li to the south; and Luzhou is a further two hundred li or so beyond that. The Yuan began building in the spring of 1273 and the foundations of the walls were visible by summer, and the Song attack of the winter of 1273 under Chen Yi was aimed precisely at interrupting that work. Equipment on both sides can also be counted: some hundreds of warships for the Song fleet of one hundred thousand men, crossbow sections and counterweight throwers with their frames on the Yuan walls at Zhengyang, and for the river itself the level and current of the Huai, which both sides used.
cause: 淮西之戰的起因有三層。最內一層是襄樊久攻不下後的必然下一步：襄樊卡在漢水上，扼住宋軍從四川、襄州往下游的通道，只要襄樊還在宋廷手中，元軍就無法順長江東下，因此元廷把取襄樊當作破局的一擊，攻下之後立刻要在淮西立一個能控制兩淮的前哨，這個前哨的選址就是水陸兩便的正陽。第二層是劉整降元帶來的情報與方案。劉整原是宋方重將，熟悉兩淮山川城守，他向元廷指出宋廷倚和議求安、內部掣肘、兩淮守兵多而指揮不一，主張先取襄樊再順流直下，他的謀劃使元軍對淮西的攻勢有了明確次序。第三層是南宋自身的失著。南宋把兩淮當作北方最後一道屏障，卻在1273年冬只由陳奕以零散州縣兵馬反覆攻正陽，未能集中兵力；1274年夏雖以十萬水軍大舉進攻，手段仍限於強攻城垣與決水灌城，沒有切斷元軍在淮西的指揮中樞，反使自己損失五百餘艘戰艦。於是局勢從元軍攻不進兩淮，變成宋軍攻不下正陽。
causeEn: The causes of the Huai-Xi campaign lie on three levels. The innermost one is the inevitable step that followed the long failure to take Xiangyang: Xiangyang stood on the Han River and blocked the Song route down from Sichuan and Xiangzhou, and as long as the city remained in Song hands the Yuan could not march down the Yangtze; the Yuan court therefore treated its capture as the blow that broke the deadlock, and once the city fell it needed at once a forward base in Huai-Xi that could hold the Two Huai, and the site chosen was Zhengyang, where the two banks of the Huai and the roads behind them met. The second level is the intelligence and the plan that came with Liu Zheng's defection. Liu Zheng had been a senior Song commander and knew the terrain and the fortresses of the Two Huai; he told the Yuan that the Song court relied on the negotiated peace for safety, that its command was divided, and that the Two Huai held many troops under confused control, and he urged that Xiangyang be taken first and the river followed afterwards, which gave the Yuan operation in Huai-Xi a definite order of operations. The third level is the Song's own misjudgement. The Song treated the Two Huai as its final northern barrier, yet in the winter of 1273 Chen Yi was allowed to attack Zhengyang only with scattered detachments from individual prefectures and no concentration of force; in the summer of 1274 ten thousand water soldiers were committed, but the methods were confined to battering the walls and flooding the outer works, and no blow was struck at the Yuan command centre in Huai-Xi, so the Song lost more than five hundred warships instead. The situation thus turned from the Yuan being unable to force the Two Huai into the Song being unable to take Zhengyang.
impact: 淮西一役的影響，首先在戰術層面：正陽兩城自此落在元軍手中，成為元軍在長江中游與下游之間的橋頭堡，淮西行省隨後改為行樞密院，性質從地方行政變成直屬中央的野戰機關。1274年秋，塔出渡淮屯駐廬州與揚州之間，阿塔海、董文炳分路南抵長江；1275年二月，董文炳在安慶與伯顏會師，阿塔海、塔出在池州與伯顏會師，四路兵馬會合後在丁家洲擊敗宋軍主力，正面攻勢由此展開，這是淮西牽制最直接的收成。其次在戰略層面：襄樊與正陽兩處失守，等於宋軍的北部防線被從中切斷，兩淮兵力被釘在淮西，既不能北上支援，也無法集中防守長江下游，一處前哨的得失改變了整條戰線的縱深。再次是對南宋內部的衝擊，和議路線被證明無效，賈似道去位，朝廷內外對蒙古的抵抗失去統一部署，臨安於1276年淪陷，宋室南走海上，終於1279年在崖山覆亡。對元朝而言，淮西的經營提供了江淮地區的通道，使其得以用漢地糧餉供應跨越長江的大軍，這條補給線在此後三年裡一直維繫著東征。
impactEn: The effects of Huai-Xi come first at the tactical level. The two towns of Zhengyang passed into Yuan hands and became the bridgehead between the middle and lower Yangtze, and the Huai-Xi provincial administration was converted into a field privy council, changing from local government into a war organ directly answerable to the centre. In the autumn of 1274 Ta Chu crossed the Huai and encamped between Luzhou and Yangzhou, and Ataqai and Dong Wenbing moved south by separate roads to the Yangtze; in the second month of 1275 Dong Wenbing joined Bayan at Anqing and Ataqai and Ta Chu joined Bayan at Chizhou, and after these four columns came together they broke the main Song army at Dingjia Zhou, which opened the frontal offensive. That was the most direct return on the fixation in Huai-Xi. Second, at the strategic level, the loss of Xiangyang and of Zhengyang together cut the Song northern defence line in half: the Two Huai forces were pinned where they stood, unable to march north to reinforce and unable to concentrate to hold the lower Yangtze, so the fall of a single forward position changed the depth of the entire front. Third came the shock inside the Song state: the negotiated peace was shown to be useless, Jia Sidao was removed, the resistance to the Mongols lost a unified command, Lin'an fell in 1276, the court fled south by sea, and the dynasty was destroyed at Yamen in 1279. For the Yuan, the Huai-Xi base opened the Jianghuai corridor and allowed the Grand Army marching across the Yangtze to be supplied from the grain of the Han country; that supply line would hold the eastern campaign together for the three years that followed.
result: 結果是元軍在淮西站住了腳。正陽兩城守住了，陳奕在1273年冬的進攻未能阻止築城，1274年夏夏貴傾兩淮兵力與十萬水軍再攻正陽也告失敗，宋軍在水陸兩線受挫，戰艦盡失，淮西防線瓦解；正陽從此成為元軍的屯兵與轉輸基地，不再是南宋的北方屏藩。此後元廷不再強攻兩淮城垣，改取迂迴，兵鋒沿長江直下，1275年二月四路兵馬會合攻宋，丁家洲一役宋軍主力崩潰，淮西兵馬隨即成為攻取臨安與兩浙的先鋒。南宋至此再無可用之兵可從兩淮調出，1276年臨安降元，宋室轉入海上流亡，最終在崖山被滅。對淮西地區本身而言，這場戰爭改變了行政與軍事的重心：宋末的州縣駐軍體系被元軍接收，地方豪族與軍頭的權力重新洗牌，元朝在此設立的州府與樞密機構，成為後來元代江淮行政與漕運格局的基礎。卡面所繪的那件十字弩，在這場戰爭裡正是攻防兩端最常見、也最被動的工具：它守住了城，卻守不住戰局。
resultEn: The result was that the Yuan kept its footing in Huai-Xi. The two towns of Zhengyang held: Chen Yi's attack in the winter of 1273 failed to stop the building, and Xia Gui's attempt in the summer of 1274 with the troops of the whole Two Huai and one hundred thousand men in the boats also failed, the Song being checked on land and water alike and losing its warships. The Huai-Xi line of defence collapsed, and Zhengyang became a garrison and supply base for the Yuan army instead of the Song's northern bulwark. From then on the Yuan court no longer forced the cities of the Two Huai but turned its approach, driving down the Yangtze; in the second month of 1275 four columns met and struck at the Song, the Song main force collapsed at Dingjia Zhou, and the Huai-Xi troops became the spearhead of the drive on Lin'an and the Two Zhe. The Song had no troops left to draw out of the Two Huai; Lin'an surrendered in 1276, the court went into exile at sea, and the dynasty was ended at Yamen. For the Huai-Xi region itself the war shifted the centre of administrative and military gravity: the Song prefectural garrison system was taken over by the Yuan army, the power of local magnates and military heads was reshuffled, and the prefectures and council offices the Yuan set up here became the basis of the later Yuan administrative and grain-transport pattern in the Jianghuai. The crossbow drawn on the card face was in this war the most common and the most passive tool on both the attacking and the defending side: it held the walls, but it could not hold the situation.
